prompt:
Create pixel-art pieces for a modern 16-bit-style top-down RPG town map (three-quarter overhead view, like a classic SNES JRPG town).

Image 1 is a PLACEMENT GUIDE on a magenta page: draw each object inside its grey box, as described. Do not copy the grey colour.

Image 2 is the HOUSE STYLE: the approved walking sprite of a character from this game at the same pixel scale as the map (about 90 sprite pixels tall). Match its sprite-pixel size, its outlines and its flat 2-3 tone shading with light from the upper left.

Image 3 is approved art from this same game map: match its colours, outline weight and shading exactly.
Image 4 is approved art from this same game map: match its colours, outline weight and shading exactly.

Pieces:
- the box in the top row of boxes, first position from the left edge of the page (144x96 sprite pixels): ONE object standing on the bottom edge of its box, as large as the box allows, with magenta all around it (no ground, no shadow on the ground, no grass under it). a town gatehouse arch seen from the front in the same three-quarter view as Image 3, filling the whole box edge to edge: the top half is the pale grey flagstone walkway on top of the town wall (the same slabs as Image 3), running across the full width; the bottom half is the front face of the same grey stone wall (the same block courses, lighter coping and darker base as Image 3) with one big round-topped gateway arch framed by light carved voussoir stones and a keystone. The arch opening is about two thirds of the box wide and rises from the bottom edge to just under the walkway; inside the opening leave EMPTY flat magenta (#FF00FF) right down to the bottom edge, so the road shows through. No doors, no portcullis, no towers, no flags.
- the box in the top row of boxes, third position from the left edge of the page (48x48 sprite pixels): ONE object standing on the bottom edge of its box, as large as the box allows, with magenta all around it (no ground, no shadow on the ground, no grass under it). the same kind of small hanging wooden shop sign board as in Image 4 (a wooden board with a dark frame hanging from a short wooden bar), showing a simple brown wooden beer tankard with white foam on top; no letters.
- the box in the middle row of boxes, third position from the left edge of the page (48x48 sprite pixels): ONE object standing on the bottom edge of its box, as large as the box allows, with magenta all around it (no ground, no shadow on the ground, no grass under it). the same kind of small hanging wooden shop sign board as in Image 4, showing a simple tall pointed white crystal with pale blue facets and a little sparkle; no letters.
- the box in the bottom row of boxes, first position from the left edge of the page (96x96 sprite pixels): ONE object standing on the bottom edge of its box, as large as the box allows, with magenta all around it (no ground, no shadow on the ground, no grass under it). a smaller version of the same gatehouse arch (a postern gate), filling the whole box edge to edge: the top half is the same pale grey flagstone wall walkway running across the full width, the bottom half the same grey stone wall face with one round-topped arch framed by light voussoir stones. The opening is about half the box wide and rises from the bottom edge to just under the walkway; inside it leave EMPTY flat magenta (#FF00FF) right down to the bottom edge. No doors, no towers.
- the box in the bottom row of boxes, second position from the left edge of the page (96x96 sprite pixels): ONE object standing on the bottom edge of its box, as large as the box allows, with magenta all around it (no ground, no shadow on the ground, no grass under it). where a town wall running from the top of the map to the bottom crosses over a road, seen from above at a three-quarter angle, filling the whole box edge to edge: the pale grey flagstone walkway on top of the wall (the same slabs as Image 3) runs from the top edge to the bottom edge as a thick stone lintel bridging the road, with a low stone parapet along its left and right edges and the light carved voussoir stones of an arch showing along its left and right sides; along the bottom edge a thin strip of the same grey wall face with a dark shadow under it. No doors, no towers, nothing outside the stonework.

Draw each piece as one continuous picture with no lines dividing it into squares. Render as true pixel art: every sprite pixel a hard-edged square, no anti-aliasing, no gradients, no blur. Between the boxes: solid flat magenta (#FF00FF), no text.
